mentions.name: MyDebugTools
mentions.description: MyDebugTools is an open-source, clean, and ad-free debugging tool designed to simplify the debugging process and help developers stay focused, with no ads or distractions.
mentions.problem: Existing debugging tools are bloated and ad-filled, distracting developers.
mentions.source_excerpt: After struggling with bloated, ad-filled debugging tools, I decided to build MyDebugTools—an open-source, clean, and ad-free debugging tool. It’s designed to simplify the debugging process and help developers stay focused. No ads, no distractions—just efficient debugging.

evidence.value: After struggling with bloated, ad-filled debugging tools, I decided to build MyDebugTools—an open-source, clean, and ad-free debugging tool. It’s designed to simplify the debugging process and help developers stay focused. No ads, no distractions—just efficient debugging.
